message: The other day, I was running around like a headless chicken trying to get everyone ready for a weekend trip. In my flurry, I remembered to grab our go-bags from the closet. I felt a little silly at first, but later that day, our car broke down on the way to the cabin. Having those bags filled with snacks, water, and some games kept the kiddos entertained while we waited for help. Sometimes it’s the little things that turn a potential disaster into just another family adventure! What’s your favorite small win that came from being prepared?
